scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/core-sdk && npm run build -w packages/workflow-engine-sdk && npm run build -w packages/connector-sdk && npm run build -w packages/asset-manager-sdk && npm run build -w packages/kaleido-sdk
scripts.build:samples: npm run build -w samples/workflow-engine-provider -w samples/erc20-indexer -w samples/btc-indexer -w samples/canton-cip56-indexer -w samples/native-eth-indexer -w samples/bulk-upsert-sample -w samples/dependency-ordering-sample --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:samples
scripts.test:packages: npm test -w packages/core-sdk -w packages/asset-manager-sdk -w packages/workflow-engine-sdk -w packages/connector-sdk -w packages/kaleido-sdk --if-present
scripts.test:samples: npm test -w samples/workflow-engine-provider -w samples/erc20-indexer -w samples/btc-indexer -w samples/canton-cip56-indexer -w samples/native-eth-indexer
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:samples
scripts.lint:packages: npm run lint -w packages/core-sdk -w packages/workflow-engine-sdk -w packages/connector-sdk -w packages/asset-manager-sdk -w packages/kaleido-sdk --if-present
